LESSON: INDIAN TRADITIONAL CALENDAR

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: General
Strand: Utsav (Festivals)
Topic 8.2: Indian Traditional Calendar

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Indian Traditional Calendar. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Indian Traditional Calendar
2. Practise Indian Traditional Calendar at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Indian Traditional Calendar

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Indian Traditional Calendar
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Indian Traditional Calendar. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Indian Traditional Calendar at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Indian Traditional Calendar at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Indian Traditional Calendar
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Indian Traditional Calendar. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Indian Traditional Calendar using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Indian Traditional Calendar in the examples.
2. Explain Indian Traditional Calendar to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Indian Traditional Calendar.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Indian Traditional Calendar using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Indian Traditional Calendar important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Indian Traditional Calendar
2. Practise Indian Traditional Calendar at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Indian Traditional Calendar

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
